hud.status-pill.data: seed 1 stone town: the mode's tag, date, population, food, coin

hud.status-pill.sandbox.data: a new sandbox from the title: the mode's tag (the building words), date, population, food, coin, the welcome closed

hud.era-ceremony.unreachable: shows only on the tick an era is entered; no cached state sits on that tick (survey §2: static contrast check only)

slot.goals.drawer.data: the goal log inside the slot

slot.goals.era-console.lord.data: the hamlet's era console in lord mode: the conditions, the plan's primary and where it stands

slot.goals.era-console.lord.plan-waiting.data: the plan waiting on a condition: each unmet one, who builds its project, the lord's lever and its way

slot.goals.era-console.lord.plan-sites.data: the plan waiting on open building sites: each with its age, and the sites the town gave up

slot.goals.era-console.lord.plan-searchi.data: the plan with every condition met and no site open: the town's turn to find the wall

slot.goals.era-console.lord.plan-asked.data: the plan with the town's request waiting: answered on its own chip

slot.goals.era-console.lord.plan-failed.data: the plan after a failed search: why, the homes cut off, the attempts and the next search

slot.population.panel.data: the population log inside the slot

slot.population.records.data: the famine town's population records after it ran (QA-028: the records, not a 22 px band)

modal.lord.request.data: the town's request (a proclamation waiting) in the DEC-CARD layout: the grant's now (the works it opens) and later (the actual's day)

slot.ledger.lord.data: the lord tab: the four policies (stability), the 10d farmstead subsidy, the draft and the dues at 80%

hud.status-pill.lord.data: the lord's slice: date, population, food, coin and the way back to town

slot.ledger.stock-lord.data: the lord's slice stock tab: the treasury by estate under the treasury line, then the stocks

slot.goals.era-console.lord.past.data: the market town's era console a season after the proclamation: the stone town's conditions, the wall's segments and priority, the plan's past line

slot.goals.era-console.lord.past-years.data: the era console four years on: the stone town's conditions, the wall further on, the plan's past line

slot.goals.market.data: the goal slot of the market town: the goal log, the settlement line past the hamlet and its progress

hud.status-pill.market.data: the market town's pill a season after the proclamation: date, population, food, coin, the way back to town

hud.status-pill.market-years.data: the pill four years on: the slice ended, the treasury nearly doubled

slot.population.growth.market.data: four years after the proclamation, a stop held: what holds the town's growth — the cause, since when (unknown after a load), the lord's lever

slot.population.growth-next.market.data: four years after the proclamation, no stop seen yet: what holds the town's next step, headed so, no since (LS1-6, A4)

hud.event-card.growth.market.data: the market town, a stop held: the chip when the stop is first said — its cause, since when, the lever, the way to the panel
